note: Every closed vocabulary in the repo that something picks from, and its address. A bank listed here can be asked for by name instead of by file path — which is the point: the organic-video library rendered blank for days because every consumer hard-coded a path and nothing noticed. Written 2026-09-11 from the survey in components/naming/FORMATS.md.
rules: address = format:<asset>:<id> for a brand-agnostic bank, format:<brand>:<asset>:<id> for a per-brand one. Same shape as the swipe: grammar in names.py, brand in the same position.
kind = what the thing IS. template = how it is built. section = what it is built FROM. style = how it is played. structure = its beat order. evidence = observed instances.
An EVIDENCE bank has no address and no entry fields. There is nothing to pick, so there is nothing to name, and giving it the shape of a choice is how it ends up in a menu.

This list is a FLOOR. It went 11 -> 17 -> 25 in one afternoon and every rise came from a different search angle. A vocabulary that was never called a format will not be found by searching for the word.

A per-brand bank must exist for EVERY brand, and the selfcheck tests every one. A brand that is genuinely missing a bank is recorded in brands_missing with the reason, so the gap is visible and stays visible. A gap that is NOT recorded fails the check — which is how the second brand stops being an afterthought.

The addressing axis is `asset`, never `lane`. `lane` already means two other things — the source lane (paid | own | organic, swipe-paid/corpus.py) and the brand positioning lane (Brotherhood / 2.0) — and an address built on a word with three meanings is the collision this registry exists to prevent.

banks.what: What kind of page it structurally is. Decided by the classifier reading the page, never chosen.

The blocks a page is assembled from. Brand-agnostic by the rule — hero-1 would build any brand's page unchanged — but it physically lives inside one brand's funnel repo, which is the one place the rule and the location disagree.
banks.location_conflict: Lives at brand-a-icon/src/icon/_includes/landing/ while being true of any brand. The second brand's funnel will either copy these 82 files or reach across to another brand's repo; both are wrong. Ruling needed before a Brand-B funnel is built, not after.

A runtime role rendered into <meta name="next-page-type"> for the Campaign Cart SDK — the repo's own words are 'it tells the SDK how to behave on this page'. Not a vocabulary we choose from, and it collides by name only with classify_pages.py:page_type().
